name: kirigami
title: A kirigami panel: rotating squares that stretch both ways
orientation: Flat on the bed, one piece, no supports: the squares lie in the bed's plane, so every neck bends within its layers. Pull it by two opposite sides.

sheet.label: The sheet: 25 squares joined at their necks

load.rule: The design pull across the sheet: 6 N stretches it 0.26 mm, and its necks may turn until it has stretched 0.57 mm before PETG's strain limit (2.18 times the margin)

pitch.rule: The squares' size, centre to centre: smaller squares make a stiffer sheet that strains its necks less for the same pull

neck.rule: Each neck's narrowest width: two lines, the thinnest that prints solid

slot.rule: Every slot's width, its ends round: four lines, so each neck's round side is as wide as the neck (r / w = 1) and the squares print well apart

depth.rule: The sheet's thickness: ten layers. Stiffness grows with it, the necks' strain for a stretch does not

across.rule: Whole squares along x, the way it is pulled
